snp1.8:1.1: What should be done by one skilled in goodness,
snp1.8:1.2: who has comprehended the state of peace:
snp1.8:1.3: he ought to be able, straight, and upright,
snp1.8:1.4: easy to speak to, meek, without conceit,
snp1.8:2.2: free from duties, and light in living,
snp1.8:2.4: not forward, and greedless among the families,
snp1.8:3.1: he should not do the slightest thing
snp1.8:3.2: whereby others who are wise might find fault (with him).
snp1.8:3.3: (May all beings) be happy and secure,
snp1.8:3.4: may all beings in their hearts be happy!
snp1.8:4.3: whether they be long or great,
snp1.8:4.4: of middle (size), short, tiny, or of compact (body),
snp1.8:5.1: those who are seen, and those who are unseen,
snp1.8:5.2: those who live far away, those who are near,
snp1.8:5.3: those who are born, and those who still seek birth
snp1.8:5.4: may all beings in their hearts be happy!
snp1.8:6.2: nor should he despise anyone wherever he is,
snp1.8:6.4: he should not long for suffering for another.
snp1.8:7.1: In the same way as a mother would protect her child, her only child,
snp1.8:7.4: one should develop the measureless thought (of friendliness).
snp1.8:8.2: he should develop the measureless thought of friendliness,
snp1.8:9.2: lying, for as long as he is without torpor,
snp1.8:9.3: he should be resolved on this mindfulness,
snp1.8:9.4: for this, they say here, is the (true) spiritual life.
snp1.8:10.3: having removed greed towards sense pleasures,
snp1.8:10.4: he does not come to lie in a womb again.
